verdict.rationale: The AWS docs index lists a first-party serverless compute service, "Run code without thinking about servers". Lambda functions are also named as callable resources, and Amplify tutorials build serverless web apps. That establishes the core capability, but the pack contains nothing on triggers, limits, or cold-start behavior. Missing for 10: documented event triggers, documented execution and resource limits, cold-start behavior documentation, serverless container option, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, small services need no servers — first-party functions/serverless containers with documented triggers, limits, and cold-start behavior
